title: LLM-assisted hypothesis generation identified an immune signal in invasive lobular breast cancer
summary: An LLM hypothesis-generation workflow, with oncologist input, surfaced an immune-signature hypothesis in invasive lobular carcinoma. The authors assessed it in METABRIC and tissue analyses. This is a human–AI collaborative result from a non-peer-reviewed preprint and does not establish treatment benefit.
ai_technology: AutoDiscovery used large language models to generate and rank data-driven hypotheses; oncologist review guided follow-up.

evidence.tested: The hypothesis was assessed in an independent METABRIC cohort and by multiplex immunofluorescence; oncologist selection contributed to the workflow.
evidence.unknown: This is a non-peer-reviewed preprint; findings do not establish response to immunotherapy or clinical benefit.
evidence.ai_role: AutoDiscovery used large language models to generate and rank hypotheses; oncologist review guided follow-up.

source_review.scope: Primary full-text review as recorded in case evidence; record-level claim and attribution review.
